1: # 缺件工单:authn-authz

3: - 需求方 preset:`aa-hr-quanjia`

5: - via:harness

7: 新零件必须走入库流水线,禁止把胶水代码直接塞进本 preset(无质检门、无供应链记录、不可复用)。

15: 
16:    node scripts/index-add.mjs scaffold <owner/repo> --pkg <npm包名> --id authn-authz

18:    纯胶水(无上游库)则手建 generated/authn-authz/{package.json,index.js,smoke.mjs},参考任一现有零件(如 generated/csv-parse/)。
19: 2. 质检门:node scripts/index-add.mjs verify authn-authz(smoke exit 0 + 独立 listTools 实探;smoke 必须真调用工具拿真结果,不许只测"能启动")
20: 3. 登记入库:node scripts/index-add.mjs register authn-authz(verify 不过会被直接拒绝;自动写 index/catalog.yml 与 capabilities.yml 的 mcp-servers 段)
21: 4. 目录条目:register 后把文末草案并入 capabilities.yml 的 `capabilities:` 段(id/描述/tags 可按实况修润)。
22:

24:

26:   - id: authn-authz
27:     via: harness

29:     tags: [auth, login, rbac, session, role-permission]

31: 
32: ## 完工闭环
33: 
34: 零件入库后重跑本次装配(同名同需求会同 id 原地换代,新零件被选中并过独立验收):
35: 
36: ```
37: /assemble 装配一个 HR 全家桶智能助手(网页界面 + 数据持久化)。功能必须全部包含: 1. 员工入职登记:录入新员工信息(姓名、工号、部门、岗位、入职日期、联系电话等),支持查看、编辑、查询员工花名册。 2. 考勤打卡统计:员工可打卡签到/签退,支持按日/按月统计出勤、迟到、早退、缺勤,支持按员工或部门汇总考勤报表。 3. 请假审批流:员工提交请假申请(事假/病假/年假/调休等,含起止日期、时长、事由),提交后进入审批流,审批人可批准/驳回,员工可查看自己申请的审批状态。 4. 月度工资条生成导出 PDF:根据员工基本工资、考勤扣款、请假扣款、社保公积金、个税等计算月度工资条,支持按月份批量生成工资条,并可导出为 PDF 文件供下载。 5. 员工问答查公司制度(带出处):员工可以用自然语言提问公司制度相关问题(如请假规则、考勤规则、福利制度、报销制度等),回答必须引用制度文档的具体出处(章节/条款/文档名),支持制度文档的维护与检索。 要求: - 数据持久化:所有数据(员工、考勤、请假、工资、制度文档)保存到持久化存储,重启不丢失。 - 有网页界面:提供可交互的网页界面(Web UI),员工和管理员可以在浏览器中使用全部功能。 - 语言:界面与交互使用中文。 - 输出预设 id 使用 aa-hr-quanjia。 --name aa-hr-quanjia
38: ```

    via: harness
    description: Search file contents by keyword and return the matching files with line numbers (grep-style content search). Also the retrieval backbone for knowledge-base Q&A — search imported docs/kb files and cite the matching file + line as the answer's source.
    tags: [search, content, grep, keyword, text, find, files, 搜索, 内容, 关键字, 查找, 知识库, 检索, 引用, 出处, 文档问答, knowledge-base, kb, rag, retrieval, citation]
    config:
      presetRows:
        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            # Required since rc.x (no schema default); false = the harness
            # base bundle's own setting (packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml).
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

  # ── persona / behavior (a capability in its own right) ────────────────────
  - id: file-manager-persona
    via: harness
    description: File-management assistant persona — lists directories, reads files, and searches file contents for the user.
    tags: [persona, tone, behavior, file, files, manager, directory, folder, list, read, search, 文件, 目录, 管理, 助手]
    config:
      # 工具名不写死:filesystem 零件随 preset 发射,serverName 带代际后缀
      # (mcp__filesystem-<hash>__read_text_file),精确名字每代不同,persona
      # 只描述工具家族与用法纪律。
      persona: |
        You are a file-management assistant. Be concise and accurate. Answer in
        the user's language. Work ONLY with your filesystem tools (their names
        start with mcp__filesystem-) — never invent file contents, and never
        use means outside your tool surface:
        - list a directory (list_directory / directory_tree) before guessing
          what exists; read files with read_text_file; find files by NAME
          pattern with search_files.
        - your reach is the workspace the tools expose — check
          list_allowed_directories when unsure, and stay inside those roots.
        When a search matches many files, summarize the matches and read the
        most relevant file before answering in detail.

  - id: cs-persona
    via: harness
    description: Customer-service agent persona — polite, concise, resolves issues before escalating.
    tags: [persona, tone, behavior, customer-service, support-agent]
    config:
      # A domain persona declares its baseline tool surface: the assembler
      # force-includes these regardless of what the requirement happened to
      # mention, so a customer-service agent always gets the full toolkit.
      baselineTools: [crm_query, ticket_create, human_handoff]
      persona: |
        You are a customer-service agent for an online electronics store.
        Be polite and concise. Answer in the user's language.
        You have three tools. Use them, do not describe using them, and do
        not explore the host with other means:
        - crm_query: check order state before claiming anything about an order.
        - ticket_create: OPEN A TICKET directly when the user reports a
          damaged item, missing item, or refund dispute. Call the tool; never
          merely say a ticket is opened without calling it.
        - human_handoff: when the user asks for a human or the issue is out
          of remit.
        Damaged items: cite the short return policy, open the ticket, then
        tell the user a human will follow up. Do not stop to ask preference
        questions before the ticket exists.

  - id: sms-gateway
    via: mcp
    description: "发送短信的网关能力:支持阿里云短信、腾讯云短信、通用 HTTP 网关(及本地 mock 联调),发送后支持查询回执;凭证经环境变量配置。"
    tags: [sms, 短信, 通知, alert, gateway, 提醒, 告警, 回执]
  - id: mobi-parser
    via: mcp
    description: "Parse MOBI/AZW3 (KF8) ebook files into plain text, metadata (title/author/language/publisher), chapter structure (spine + TOC), and per-chapter text — the MOBI counterpart of the existing PDF/DOCX extractors. Pure local parsing, no network."
"}],"isError":false}],"role":"user","id":"83601c78-7890-495b-b5f8-b60b933f859c"}}
